about: netconvert warnings of the network build, each class fixed or justified. pass2_final_network is the shipped sim/net/roads.net.xml.

turn_signs_not_applicable.reason: OSM turn:lanes arrows that do not fit the roads actually connected (arrow counts and targets differ); netconvert falls back to its own lane assignment for that approach. Where that left a one-sided approach without its turn, turn_lanes.con.xml adds it.

sharp_turn.reason: OSM geometry bends more tightly than a car could turn where a way meets a junction (usually a slip lane or a short joined-junction approach). Edge geometry is visual only in SUMO: it changes neither speed nor routing.

segment_angle.reason: A kink in the OSM geometry of the edge: visual only.

junction_shape_offset.reason: Large joined junctions whose outline is offset from the merged node position: geometry.

turn_speed_reduced.reason: SUMO lowers the speed through a junction where the path through it curves; that is the intended physics, not an error.

intersecting_turns.reason: Two opposing turns across the centre line (right turns here: in a left-hand network SUMO's 'left turn' check covers them) whose paths overlap inside a compact junction. SUMO does not make such turns foes, so two cars turning at once may overlap visually inside the junction; flow is unaffected (no teleports at these junctions in the smoke runs). A larger junction radius everywhere would distort the city geometry instead.
